Subject: Post-demo recap + MAP next steps (ACME pilot)

Hey Alex — great demo this morning, thanks for the time. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we all have the same timeline: 

- Success criteria: 95th pctl latency < 350ms for 1k qps test, accuracy on your core intent evaluator >= 92% (as discussed).
- Pilot scope: 3 customer-facing endpoints (search reranking, zero-shot summarization, chat-assist).
- TIMELINE (target): pilot kickoff 2026-04-06, internal validation week of 2026-04-27, go-live pilot 2026-05-04.
- Responsibilities: ACME to provide test dataset and access to staging environment by 2026-03-27; Redwood will provision dedicated cluster and deliver MAP + SOW by 2026-03-25.
- Dependencies: procurement approval, security questionnaire (SOC2 evidence), and procurement signature.

I attached a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and SOW draft. Please review and flag any changes to milestones or owners. If the timeline looks tight, we can slide kickoff a week.

Next steps: can you confirm dates for procurement and security review? Also who from your side will own the test-data handoff?

Thanks —

Marissa — thanks for the clear notes. Quick answers: 

- Procurement: target internal approval by 2026-04-01, legal will review SOW this week.
- Security: Priya is leading the SOC2 evidence review; she expects to finish by 2026-03-30.
- Test-data owner: Myself and Priya will coordinate; we can hand off a de-identified sample by 2026-03-27 as requested.

If those two items are captured I'm comfortable moving to a final MAP and routing SOW to legal.
